name: esp2026_p27_belt_strap_buckle
title: ESP 2026 part 27: belt webbing, buckle side

steps.title: Strap up from the anchor
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as belt_strap_buckle.ipt.
Sketch a 2 x 48 rectangle. Extrude 31 mm up.

steps.title: Strap across the cushion
actions: Sketch a 2 x 48 rectangle on the side face. Extrude 187 mm across. Save.
steps.note: Shown short and laid flat: in use the webbing goes round the lap.
